title: Untitled (Flag) [Bandana]

description.main: Barbara Kruger's Untitled (Flag), a 2020 bandana made for Artists Band Together, a fundraiser for groups working to raise turnout in the 2020 U.S. election.
description.extended:
Barbara Kruger's Untitled (Flag), a 2020 bandana made for Artists Band Together, a fundraiser for groups working to raise turnout in the 2020 U.S. election.

The design lays out the American flag in words. White capitals on the blue canton read "Look for the moment when pride becomes contempt," and the stripes are ten questions in white italic capitals, running from "Who is free to choose?" through who is healed, housed and silenced to "Who laughs last?" It is silkscreened on white cotton, about 55 cm square.

Fifteen artists designed bandanas for the project, among them Shepard Fairey, Jenny Holzer, Marilyn Minter and Hank Willis Thomas. eBay for Charity sold them until November 1, 2020, with all proceeds split between Rise, Mijente and Woke Vote. Kruger's design came out in the second release, on September 1. Curator Nora Halpern tied the project to the bandana's history as a symbol of unity.
description.artist_bio: Barbara Kruger (b. 1945, Newark) is an American conceptual artist associated with the Pictures Generation. After working as a designer and picture editor at Conde Nast magazines, she began in the late 1970s to pair found black-and-white photographs with declarative text in Futura Bold Oblique, white on red. The Barbara Kruger Catalogue Raisonne (barbarakruger.org) documents the work; she is represented by Sprueth Magers and David Zwirner.

notes: Untitled (Flag), 2020, silkscreen on cotton, 21.5 x 21.5 in. (55 x 55 cm). Open edition made for Artists Band Together, released September 1, 2020, per eBay's press release of August 17, 2020. The Museum of Fine Arts, Boston holds a copy (2021.325). Not signed.
